objectives: Recognise kn as a spelling pattern with silent initial k.
Compare vowel sounds and endings in knee, knot, knit, and knock.
Decode complete kn-words instead of guessing from the first letter.
Explain the difference between written letters and spoken sounds.
concepts: The initial k is silent in the taught kn words.
The rime includes the vowel and following sounds.
Whole-word decoding checks the vowel and ending.
